The history of memecoins:
•2013: $DOGE - The OG, born from a meme, now a movement.
•2020: $SHIB - The “DOGE killer” that turned pennies into fortunes.
•2021: $SAFEMOON - Promises of the moon, lessons in gravity.
•2023: $PEPE - Frog memes, liquidity wars, and chaos.
•2025:

BTC ATH is the appetizer.

The main course?

Retail panic-buying Pepe, $DOGE on Solana, and airdrops you’ll never claim.
